skills.trigger: When evaluating serial chest X-rays to determine the progression or resolution of pulmonary opacities.
steps: Identify and map specific zones of consolidation (e.g., peripheral vs. perihilar) on the baseline image.
Compare the density and extent of these specific zones on the follow-up image against the baseline.
Distinguish between global improvement (clearing in all zones), partial improvement (clearing in one zone with stability in another), and worsening (increased density or spread).
Correlate the pattern of clearing (e.g., resolution of both peripheral and perihilar opacities) with clinical recovery from inflammatory or infectious processes.
